# The New Yorker

> The New Yorker is a weekly magazine and digital platform delivering award-winning journalism, cultural criticism, fiction, humor, and commentary on politics, arts, and international affairs.

Founded in 1925, The New Yorker combines investigative reporting with literary fiction, cartoons, and cultural reviews. The publication covers major global events including Middle East conflicts, U.S. politics, and cultural trends, while maintaining a strong tradition of humor, satire, and the iconic New Yorker cartoon.

## Key Topics

- Iran war
- Middle East conflict
- Politics and opinion
- Cultural criticism
- Fiction and poetry

## Core News & Opinion

- [The New Yorker Homepage](https://www.newyorker.com): The New Yorker homepage with news, culture, and opinion coverage
- [News, Politics, Opinion, Commentary, and Analysis](https://www.newyorker.com/news): News hub with politics, Middle East coverage, and opinion essays
- [The Latest](https://www.newyorker.com/latest): Latest articles, news, and content from The New Yorker
- [What the War Has Done to Iranians](https://www.newyorker.com/news/dispatch/what-the-war-has-done-to-iranians): Dispatch from Tehran on Iran war impact by Cora Engelbrecht
- [The Iran War Is Another Reason to Quit Oil](https://www.newyorker.com/news/the-lede/the-iran-war-is-another-reason-to-quit-oil): Bill McKibben on Iran war and renewable energy policy
- [The Unravelling of Dubai as a Safe Haven](https://www.newyorker.com/news/the-unravelling-of-dubai-as-a-safe-haven): Analysis of Dubai's security concerns amid Iran-UAE tensions
- [The Right to a Bed in Zohran Mamdani's New York](https://www.newyorker.com/news/new-york-journal/the-right-to-a-bed-in-zohran-mamdanis-new-york): NYC homelessness policy analysis on Bellevue shelter closure

## Culture, Arts & Entertainment

- [Culture: TV, Movies, Music, Art, and Theatre News and Reviews](https://www.newyorker.com/culture): Culture section featuring TV, film, music, and arts reviews
- [Goings On](https://www.newyorker.com/goings-on): NYC culture recommendations and entertainment guide
- [Remembering Calvin Tomkins, a Master of the Profile](https://www.newyorker.com/culture/postscript/remembering-calvin-tomkins-a-master-of-the-profile): Obituary and tribute to New Yorker profile writer Calvin Tomkins
- [An Elegy for the Kennedy Center](https://www.newyorker.com/culture/the-lede/an-elegy-for-the-kennedy-center): Alex Ross on Kennedy Center renovation and cultural impact
- [Why Can't You Finish Anything?](https://www.newyorker.com/culture/open-questions/why-cant-you-finish-anything): Joshua Rothman on procrastination and unfinished projects

## Fiction, Poetry & Humor

- [Fiction and Poetry](https://www.newyorker.com/fiction-and-poetry): Original fiction, poetry, and literary content from The New Yorker
- [Humor, Satire, and Cartoons](https://www.newyorker.com/humor): Humor section with cartoons, satire, and comedic content

## Audio, Video & Interactive

- [The New Yorker Podcasts](https://www.newyorker.com/podcasts): Audio content hub with journalism, culture, and fiction podcasts
- [Video](https://www.newyorker.com/video): Documentaries and narrative short films from The New Yorker
- [Crossword Puzzles and Trivia Games](https://www.newyorker.com/crossword-puzzles-and-games): Daily crosswords, cryptics, and interactive trivia games

## Subscriptions & Community

- [Subscribe](https://www.newyorker.com/newsletters): Newsletter subscription hub featuring daily digests and curated content
